opening.argument: The video shows a referral promotion for a cryptocurrency trading platform, not an established deceptive solicitation. The speaker describes Binance as a place to use Bitcoin to buy altcoins, shows its registration page, and tells viewers to sign up through a link he identifies as his referral. He urges prompt registration, but frames the possibility of registration closing again as a possibility, not a certainty. The referral benefit to the speaker and the urgency are clear. The available content, however, does not promise viewers a return or ask them to send money or provide data to the creator. Those limits matter when assessing what the registration request actually establishes.
